name: city_decay

edit_overlay.title: What if every human vanished… right now?
edit_overlay.counter: Population (8.2 billion) on the opening beat, then the year label. Composite after the beauty PNGs with whatif/engine/overlay.py. Not burned into these frames.
edit_overlay.sfx: Cue sheet only (sfx.json). Not in this blend.

notes: Ready-made Procedural City 6 for day 1. Ruined City Free 5 replaces it when collapse passes 0.5. Both are meshes in the blend.
Street fog is a Principled Volume with height falloff. No fluid cache.
No rigid-body simulation. Era hides, sun, fog density, and weather cards are keyframed for frames 1-1800.
No add-on is required on Colab. Cell Fracture, Ivy Gen, and A.N.T. Landscape are not used in this scene.
Drone beats (frames 1097-1426) stay on the wide camera. Those paths still target the old river city and were not retargeted.
The handmade river-city episode is a different blend and is not in this bundle.

CPU timing is the mean wall clock of a clean unpack on this 4-thread VM (no GPU): frame 1 was 54 s (Cycles 53.0 s), frame 871 was 72 s (Cycles 70.4 s). Both PNGs are 1080x1920 RGB. Textures were packed; neither frame is missing-texture magenta.
est_sec_per_frame_t4 is that 63 s mean divided by 4. It is not a measurement. This machine has no OptiX device. Split the 1800 frames with START END if a free Colab session is shorter than the guess.
